newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 6.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - President Henri Konan Bedie urges lawmakers at special lunch to vote draft law giving police wide-ranging powers to deal with violent crime. Opposition and human rights leaders are opposed to the draft's provision for police searches of homes without a magistrate's warrant. - President Bedie says he is satisfied with work of Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan; dismisses speculation over possible sacking of Duncan. LA VOIE - About 10,000 workers on strike at agro-industrial complex Palmindustrie - President Bedie limits powers of Prime Minister Duncan; removes the important DCGTX department responsible for major government construction projects from premier's control. LE JOUR - Security Minister Marcel Dibonan Kone says bandits blamed for rising insecurity will be defeated. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
